package.description: Cloud-based 3D CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB platform for product design and manufacturing.

en-US.description: Cloud-based 3D CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB platform for product design and manufacturing.
en-US.longDescription: Autodesk Fusion is a cloud-based 3D modeling, CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB software platform that connects design and manufacturing in one product. It combines 3D modeling, simulation, machining, electronics, rendering, and data management tools, so teams can take products from concept to production and collaborate in a shared workspace.
en-US.name: Autodesk Fusion

zh-CN.description: 基于云的 3D CAD、CAM、CAE 和 PCB 平台，用于产品设计与制造。
zh-CN.longDescription: Autodesk Fusion 是一个基于云的 3D 建模、CAD、CAM、CAE 和 PCB 软件平台，将设计与制造连接在同一产品中。它集 3D 建模、仿真、加工、电子、渲染和数据管理工具于一体，帮助团队从概念走向量产，并在共享工作区中协同工作。
